svg.text: centralwatch: split a flat alert-routing stack into three modules
A central monitoring account routes operational events through EventBridge, SQS and an enricher Lambda to per-team, per-severity and per-channel SNS topics, all
in one flat Terraform root indexed by list position. The agent splits it into eventing, messaging and processing modules keyed by team, source, severity and channel,
and the plan against production must contain nothing but moves.

against the state, then the policies

AFTER: FOR_EACH KEY IN ITS MODULE
No list is alphabetical: locals.tf keeps 10 teams in rollout order (operations first, payments last), 7 sources, 5 severities (critical, warning, emergency, info, high) and 4
channels in runbook order, so a key cannot be guessed from the index.
